reasons: No manufacturer, part number, dimensions or approval document was given for this generic candy green 5-spoke front wheel.
No source found shows this exact part is approved for BMW R NineT 2014-2016; without ABE, Teilegutachten or E-mark coverage legal use cannot be confirmed.
Fit depends on unknown rim size, offset, axle / spacer size, load rating and ABS ring / brake disc compatibility on an ABS bike.
toMeasure: Manufacturer, part number and whether ABE or Teilegutachten names BMW R NineT 2014-2016 with ABS
Rim diameter x width, offset, axle diameter, load rating and approved tyre sizes
Whether wheel includes matching ABS tone ring / sensor and brake-disc mounting for 2014-2016 R NineT
Fender and fork clearance with new wheel / tyre combination
extraParts: ABS tone ring / sensor hardware if not included
matching brake discs / spacers / mounting hardware
conditions: Only use with ABE or Teilegutachten that explicitly lists BMW R NineT 2014-2016 with ABS.
Carry ABE or Teilegutachten and any inspection report until papers are updated.
Possible Aenderungsabnahme or Einzelabnahme as inspector decides; success is not guaranteed and depends on documents, fitment and retained ABS / brake function.
Ensure front and rear candy green 5-spoke wheels are approved as a combination with intended tyres.
Check that the ABS ring and sensor fit the new wheel.
Check tire and fender clearance and the brake and drive fit after the wheel swap.
